input: Schedule a chimney sweep before the first fire

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a Chimney Sweep Before First Fire
gold.taskDescription: Find and book a chimney sweep service in time before lighting the first fire of the season.

questions.title: When do you plan to use the fireplace first?
questions.description: Identify the target date or season for the first fire to set a booking deadline.

questions.title: What type of fireplace or heating appliance is it?
questions.description: Determine whether it is a wood-burning fireplace, wood stove, gas fireplace, pellet stove, or other type.

questions.title: When was the chimney last professionally cleaned?
questions.description: Understand the maintenance history to gauge urgency and the scope of work needed.

questions.title: Do you already have a chimney sweep company in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preferred or previously used service provider, or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What city or area should the sweep service be in?
questions.description: Capture the location so that local providers can be identified.

questions.title: Do you need an inspection done alongside the cleaning?
questions.description: Determine if a full safety inspection is also required, which affects provider selection and cost.

questions.title: Are there specific days or times you are available for the appointment?
questions.description: Identify scheduling constraints so the booking can be arranged around the user's availability.
